cases.prompt: Install Orbit on this laptop, initialize it in my repository and register it with my agent client.
cases.expected: Loads orbit-setup, detects what is already installed, reads references/first-run-machine.md and references/first-run-workspace.md, and ends with an audited operation through the real client rather than a version string.

cases.prompt: Promote the approved tasks in my Orbit backlog and start a drain for the next two hours.
cases.expected: Loads orbit-orchestrate for promotion and dispatch. Does not install, configure or enable scheduler components.

cases.prompt: This existing workspace should carry only the worktree-gc and store-gc routines and the doc-duties auto-task. Narrow what it seeds.
cases.expected: Reads references/configuration-layers.md. Inspects effective values with orbit config show --all, saves local definition edits, sets seeding.routines and seeding.auto_tasks as name lists, previews with orbit workspace sync --check --json before applying, and verifies with orbit workspace show. Enables nothing the user did not ask for.
